audio_semantics: SFX identities, speech and music not inferred from RMS/spectral metrics
limits: 0.1s bins are measurement granularity, not semantic annotation precision.
Cuts may be missed or false-positive on flashes, camera movement and crossfades.
Dense optical flow mixes subject motion and camera motion and does not prove lens/camera settings.
SFX, captions, expression changes, transitions and playback-speed events require separate viewing/listening validation.
No original edit speed inferred from observed motion.

timeline_time_origin: First decoded VIDEO frame PTS = 0; audio windows shifted by video/audio start offset. Video endpoint estimated using final PTS plus median frame interval.
